title: Deep copy a connected graph
summary: Photocopy a web of friends, keeping a notebook of who is already copied so nobody is copied twice and every friendship is redrawn.
goal: Make an independent copy of the whole friendship web

mapping.formal: A new graph with the same shape

examples.label: Four friends in a ring
examples.explanation: The copy has the same friendships, but every node is new.

examples.label: One person
examples.explanation: A single person with no friends.

examples.label: No people
examples.explanation: An empty web copies to an empty web.

ladder.name: Copy people, then friendships
ladder.idea: First walk the web to list every person and make a copy of each. Then walk again, wiring each copy's friendships through the list.

ladder.name: Copy as you go, with a notebook
ladder.idea: Walk the web depth-first. The first time you meet a person, copy them and note the copy; then copy their friends and link them. A person already in the notebook is linked, not copied again.
ladder.insight: A notebook from original to copy lets each friendship be wired the moment it is seen, and stops the walk from looping forever around cycles of friends.

transfer.problem: Copy a linked list where each node also has a pointer to a random other node in the list.
transfer.explanation: Map each original node to its copy as you go, so random pointers can be wired to the right copies.

selfCheck: Records a copy in the notebook before copying its neighbours.
Reuses notebook copies for people seen before.
Never links a copy to an original node.
